# note: javaagent transform-on-load + nio readAttributes(view:attrs) converged the agent section in both arms; regex/textformat/text converged on dev since the first freeze

# note: JNI argument/return marshalling is fixed — the thirteen filed families plus a new upcall-exception family all match HotSpot 25 in both modes over three consecutive three-arm runs, so JdkOnlyPlatformProbe real/jni and strict/jni come off. Removed by hand rather than by --update-baseline: that regenerates the whole set from ONE run, and two runs of this gate ten minutes apart disagreed about */vthreads (both arms diverging, then neither), so a regenerate would have written the documented intermittent section out on a coin flip. Dropping two measured lines can only tighten the ratchet.
#
# The gate fails when this set GROWS. A line that stops diverging is
